items.item_text: Related education and general nursing work experience including a valid license to practice as a Registered Nurse in the State of California
Possession of a current State of California Nursing License, in good standing
Related experience or skills, knowledge, and abilities such as those attained through 1 year of clinical experience in a family practice or student health setting
Recent experience with electronic medical records

Under the medical direction of physicians and the clinical supervision of the Clinic Director, the Clinical Nurse performs patient care at the Student Health Center and completes a variety of established nursing procedures using current clinical knowledge. The incumbent works with an interdisciplinary team within a scope defined by Student Health Services policies and relevant California State and other applicable regulations. The Clinical Nurse exercises professional judgment in the day-to-day operation of nursing-staffed functions and acts as a role model and mentor to other nurses, staff, and students.
Ability to apply clinical judgement appropriately and seek medical consultation when necessary
Knowledge of standard infection control practices, including the use of universal precautions and sterile technique
Excellent communication and listening skills with the ability to maintain a positive communication style during all interactions
Ability to provide and promote excellent customer service and to respectfully respond to patient-centered preferences, needs, and values
Ability to use standard clinical equipment per regulatory standards and guidelines and to operate necessary safety and medical equipment as needed
Ability to work cooperatively and independently at times with minimal supervision
Demonstrated flexibility, organizational, and prioritization skills
Adept multitasking skills with frequent interruptions and time constraints
Ability to handle difficult, sensitive, and confidential situations tactfully
